dz: 霍斯罗一世在父亲卡瓦德一世去世后成为萨萨尼德帝国的国王. 他开始与拜占庭帝国谈判以结束伊比利亚战争.
de: Khosrow I becomes king of the Sassanid Empire following the death of his father Kavad I. He starts negotiations with the Byzantine Empire to end the Iberian War.
